Social Media Manager — Dietitian Sheenam LLP, Mohali
Experience: 2–4 Years
Key Responsibilities
- Manage Instagram and YouTube end-to-end.
- Create and execute monthly content strategies and calendars.
- Plan engaging Reels, YouTube Shorts, long-form videos, carousels and stories.
- Develop strong hooks, captions, titles, CTAs and content ideas.
- Research trends, competitors and viral content opportunities.
- Manage YouTube SEO, thumbnails, titles and descriptions.
- Track analytics including reach, views, watch time, engagement, retention and follower/subscriber growth.
- Continuously optimize content based on performance.
- Focus on organic growth, brand building and generating qualified enquiries.
Requirements
- 2–4 years of experience in social media management.
- Strong understanding of Instagram and YouTube algorithms.
- Excellent content ideation and copywriting skills.
- Knowledge of Canva, CapCut/Premiere Pro preferred.
- Good understanding of trends, audience psychology and analytics.
- Portfolio of Instagram/YouTube work is mandatory.
